text: In a Mexican city torn by the drug war, gunfire empties Estrella's classroom and her teacher hands her [three pieces of chalk that grant three wishes|rules|everything has a price]. Then [her mother vanishes|trigger|someone goes missing], and a trail of blood follows Estrella home. She joins a gang of street orphans led by the scarred boy Shine, who has stolen a gangster's phone, while [her mother's ghost begs her to bring him to them|threat|the restless dead] and [a politician's killers hunt the children|wrong|the powerful abuse their power].
